boundary: Live native source rendering at 1920x1080 Medium/60 cap, repeated eight-car races on the explicitly recorded courses. RSS includes renderer/audio/scene resources. This host can have other applications/emulators active; no minimum-device or physical thermal budget claim.

native.boundary: Live source client, normally paced eight-car races on the recorded courses, production loading/HUD/render-scale path, ordinary diagnostic AI inputs. Repeated scene lifetime exercise on this host; not exported-template, minimum-hardware, human driving, physical Android or thermal acceptance.
native.frame_timing: Wall-clock microseconds between RenderingServer.frame_post_draw callbacks, including OS scheduling; excludes loading/menu/countdown. No engine simulation-delta or fixed-fps movie timing.

memory.scope: All scene/loading transition peaks retained, 5–15 minute repeated-course high-water comparison. Separate from a continuous worst-track hardware test.
